newsitem.title: NORWAY: SOCCER-NORWEGIAN MINNOWS HOPE TO SURPRISE MILAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NORWEGIAN MINNOWS HOPE TO SURPRISE MILAN.

text.p: Rosenborg coach Nils Arne Eggen gave his players a roasting on Tuesday, saying they faced a 9-0 pasting by Italian giants AC Milan in the European Cup on Wednesday unless they improved sharply.
Eggen, fully aware of the gargantuan task of pitting his part-timers against the likes of George Weah, Zvonomir Boban and Edgar Davids, admitted he was trying to psyche his players up.

"I was trying to raise the temperature. They're pretty fed up now but they've got reason to be after today's performance," Eggen said after screaming abuse at his players during a 90-minute training session.

Both Rosenborg and Milan performed contrary to expectations in their opening Champions' League Group D matches two weeks ago, the Norwegians beating Gothenburg 3-2 in Sweden and the Italians losing 3-2 at home to Portugal's Porto.
Milan, who beat Bologna 2-1 away in the Italian league on Sunday, face temperatures nudging zero in this central Norwegian town.
They know that to finish second in Group D would risk an unwanted quarter-final clash with compatriots Juventus, the likely Group C winners.
"Against Rosenborg we'll go all out to win and above all we've got to get a result without being too fussy about how we get it," striker Marco Simone said.
Milan's Uruguayan coach Oscar Washington Tabarez believes his side is back on course following successive defeats against Porto and, in the Italian league, Sampdoria.

He said after Sunday's victory: "This is a very important win because there's a bit of everything in it, above all the stress felt by a side like ours which simply cannot allow itself to lose two successive league games."
Milan's only selection doubts are in defence. Veteran Pietro Vierchowod is cup-tied but coach Tabarez hopes 36-year-old captain Franco Baresi may recover in time to replace him.
If Baresi proves unready, then Tabarez can play either Filippo Galli or Frenchman Marcel Desailly alongside Alessandro Costacurta, with Dutchman Edgar Davids replacing Desailly in midfield.
In attack, Simone partners George Weah and Montenegrin Dejan Savicevic thus again ruling out Roberto Baggio. Croat Zvonimir Boban and Demetrio Albertini are certain starters in midfield.
Rosenborg - Jorn Jamtfall; Erik Hoftun, Bjorn Bragstad, Stale Stensaas, Jon Olav Hjelde; Bjorn Kvarme, Rune Bratseth, Kare Ingebrigtsen; Harald Brattbakk, Jahn Ivar Jakobsen, Kristian Sorli.
AC Milan - Sebastiano Rossi; Christian Panucci, Alessandro Costacurta, Marcel Desailly, Paolo Maldini; Edgar Davids, Demetrio Albertini, Zvonimir Boban; Dejan Savicevic, George Weah, Marco Simone.
